description_en: Queries the backup list of an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
name: DescribeBackups

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.
If you set this parameter to the ID of a sharded cluster instance, you must also specify the NodeId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
当本参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，还需要传入NodeId参数
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the shard node in the sharded cluster instance.

This parameter is required if you set the DBInstanceId parameter to instance ID of a sharded cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
分片集群实例中Shard节点的ID。

当DBInstanceId参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，本参数必填
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

If you set the DBInstanceId parameter to the ID of a sharded cluster instance, the number of instance IDs is the same as the number of shard nodes. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
备份ID。

当DBInstanceId参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，备份ID个数与Shard节点个数相同，中间用英文逗号（,）间隔
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30 (default)
50
100
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：

30（默认值）
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format (UTC). This parameter is invalid if BackupId is specified
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 当传入BackupId时，此参数无效
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format (UTC). This parameter is invalid if BackupId is specified
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 当传入BackupId时，此参数无效
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The region where the instance resides.


This parameter is required to restore a deleted instance.
This parameter is required for geo-redundancy backups
parameters.help_zh:
实例所在地域。


已删除实例恢复必填。
异地备份必填
parameters.name: src_region

parameters.help_en:
The region where the backup resides.


This parameter is required for geo-redundancy backups
parameters.help_zh:
备份所在地域。


异地备份必填
parameters.name: dest_region

schema.description_en: The backup information of the instance

Backup.description_en: The list of backup file details

items.description_en: The list of backup file details

BackupDBNames.description_en: The name of the backed-up database

BackupDownloadURL.description_en: The public download URL of the backup file. An empty string is returned if the backup file is currently unavailable for download
BackupDownloadURL.description_zh: 备份文件的外网下载地址，若当前不可下载，则返回为空字符串

BackupEndTime.description_en: The end time of the backup. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
BackupEndTime.description_zh: 本次备份结束时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

BackupExpireTime.description_en: The time when the backup expires. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). "9999-01-01T00:00:00Z" indicates long-term retention (LTR).>
BackupExpireTime.description_zh: 备份过期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 "9999-01-01T00:00:00Z"表示长期保留。>

BackupIntranetDownloadURL.description_en:
The internal download URL of the backup file.

You can use this URL to download the backup file from an ECS instance that is in the same network as the ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
BackupIntranetDownloadURL.description_zh:
备份文件的内网下载地址。

您可以通过该地址在ECS服务器（与云数据库MongoDB实例在同一网络）上下载目标备份文件

BackupMethod.description_en:
The backup method. Valid values:
Snapshot: snapshot backup.
Physical: physical backup.
Logical: logical backup
BackupMethod.description_zh:
备份方式，取值说明：
Snapshot：快照备份。
Physical：物理备份。
Logical：逻辑备份

BackupMode.description_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:
Automated: automatic backup.
Manual: manual backup
BackupMode.description_zh:
备份模式，取值说明：
Automated：系统自动备份。
Manual：手动备份

BackupName.description_en: The backup set name. This parameter is currently invalid

BackupScale.description_en: The backup granularity. This parameter is currently invalid

BackupSize.description_en: The size of the backup file. Unit: bytes

BackupStartTime.description_en: The start time of the backup. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
BackupStartTime.description_zh: 本次备份开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

BackupStatus.description_en:
The backup status. Valid values:
Success: The backup is successful.
Failed: The backup failed
BackupStatus.description_zh:
备份状态，取值说明：
Success：备份成功。
Failed：备份失败

BackupType.description_en:
The backup type. Valid values:
FullBackup: full backup.
IncrementalBackup: incremental backup
BackupType.description_zh:
备份类型，取值说明：
FullBackup：全量备份。
IncrementalBackup：增量备份

EngineVersion.description_en:
The database engine version of the instance when the backup was created. Valid values:
7.0
6.0
5.0
4.4
4.2
4.0
3.4

IsAvail.description_en:
Indicates whether the backup set is available. Valid values:
0: unavailable.
1: available
IsAvail.description_zh:
备份集是否可用，取值说明：
0：不可用。
1：可用

PageSize.description_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30 (default)
50
100
PageSize.description_zh:
每页记录数，取值：

30（默认值）
50
100
